mutants.name: wrong-letter-c
mutants.why: the benign set is {c, d}; a (c)-lettered FAIL is swallowed at deposit and release — every consumer that counts non-benign FAILs must see (y)

mutants.name: remove-fail-echo-lens
mutants.why: lens_commit must echo FAIL lines so authors see the plan_lint FAIL before cycle_check refuses; removing the echo hides it

mutants.name: remove-warn-echo-lens
mutants.why: lens_commit must echo WARN lines so authors see plan_lint WARNs at commit time; removing the echo hides them

mutants.name: remove-fail-rows-close
mutants.why: the battery FAIL message must include the FAIL rows so the author can see the (y) row; clearing fail_rows drops the diagnostic
mutants.anchor: fail_rows = [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith("FAIL: ")]

mutants.name: remove-warn-echo-close
mutants.why: close_cycle must echo plan_lint WARN lines before its battery verdict so authors see WARNs at close time; removing the echo hides them
